target_customer: Indian millennials splitting bills in offline group settings
problem: Splitting group expenses means awkward reminders, delayed payments and multiple transactions.

founders.name: Aniruddh Singh
education: Kellogg MBA in progress per YC page
founders.background_notes: YC page bio: ex-founder and CEO of goDutch (YC W20); pursuing an MBA at Kellogg. Described as an IIT Bombay graduate.

founders.name: Riyaz Khan
education: IIT Bombay per YC page company description

technical_complexity.rationale: Payments integration and card linking in India with UPI and regulation dependencies.

defensibility.rationale: Payment apps such as Google Pay and Paytm could add split features, and later did.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Google Pay added bill splitting in 2021 and Paytm added Split Bills later, per search results.

market_need_then: Rising UPI use and a Business Insider India headline calling goDutch India's answer to Splitwise.

branding.name_origin: Plays on the phrase going Dutch (each pays their share); no source from the company confirms it.
branding.domain_note: godutchpay.in rather than a .com; a Dutch business bank named GoDutch exists since 2024.

brand_strength.rationale: The pun is clear but there was no coverage of the brand; later a Dutch company took a near identical name.

outcome_analysis: goDutch raised a $1.7 million seed led by Matrix Partners India in July 2020 for a bill splitting app, with IIT Bombay founders. YC lists it inactive, and only an autopsy aggregator claims an end in 2023 with no primary source, so the cause is not public. Payment apps adding native split features is analysis, not a sourced cause.
notes: Seed is stated by several outlets (TheNewsMinute, Corporate Professionals, YourStory, Business Insider India via search listings); loot-drop says $1.6M, treated as less reliable. I could not open Business Insider India or YourStory, so the Splitwise competitor source rests on the headline in search results. Riyaz Khan's IIT claim comes from the YC description of the founders as IIT Bombay grads. godutchpay.in returned 503. The 2023 end date is unverified.
